name: Anton Petrov
source:
Anton's family just moved to a new house, so he has no friends. He reads a lot and likes drawing. He often watches children's cartoons with his sister Olya, and enjoys it even though he doesn't want to admit it. 

Anton dislikes the forest view which can be seen through his room's windows.
